thread:
ara (PM): Quick sync — Q3 pricing decisions. We need clear guidance on annual commit tiers vs pay-as-you-go, and what add-ons (priority SLA, dedicated pool, eval credits) are table-stakes for launch. Sales are already asking for flexibility in contracts.

matt (RevOps): Can we put baseline numbers on committed vCPU/GPU hours or committed token units? Sales needs anchors ± discount bands. Also want rules for rollovers and overage pricing.

danielle (Acct Exec): +1. Big E customer asked for a 12mo commit with burst credits and the ability to add a mid-contract seat bundle. They pushed back on per-token overage — want spend collar instead.

lee (Eng): From infra side, tiers map to provisioning profiles: "shared-hosted", "reserved-small", "reserved-large". Add-ons that need infra work: dedicated pool and soft real-time routing. ETA for gating and telemetry: 3 sprints.

ara (PM): So prioritize: 1) define commit units & rollover policy, 2) add-on definitions + infra cost estimate, 3) launch guardrails (SLA language, throttles). Agree?

matt (RevOps): Draft proposal: three commit bands (S, M, L) with annual commit in token-units, 10% rollover cap, overage at 1.5x spot until threshold, then 2x. Discounts scale with band. Will model impact today.

danielle (Acct Exec): For enterprise deals, need add-on table: dedicated pool (min commit), premium support (SLA 99.9 + 30m P1), eval credits (30d, non-transferable). Also request a "flex clause" for one-time mid-contract addon without re-negotiating full T&C.

nina (Legal): Flex clause ok but limit to 1 per 12mo and require amendment sign-off. Must include export control & data residency options for private deployments. Also watch termination for convenience — pricing refunds need clear rules.

lee (Eng): One more infra note: dedicated pools require min sustained utilization otherwise cost sinks. Recommend min commit for dedicated = 50% utilization over a rolling 30d. Otherwise fall back to shared billing.

ara (PM): Launch criteria proposal: doc with commit bands, add-on definitions + min commits, legal-approved contract language, RevOps pricing matrix, and infra cost model. If any of the five missing, we don't ship.

matt (RevOps): I'll push a draft pricing matrix to the doc: https://redwood.internal/pricing/q3-commit-draft (WIP). Expect numbers by EOD tomorrow.

danielle (Acct Exec): I'll flag two deals that need the flex clause — will ping legal + RevOps offline.

nina (Legal): I'll prep amendment template and redline the flex clause.

opsbot: Note: previous tier change (2025-11-02) archived. Reference id: PRC-20251102.

ara (PM): Thanks. Next - can we have a quick 15m tomorrow to lock the band thresholds? Ping if blocked. :thumbsup:
